texts.preamble: V.Nandakumar vs The Secretary on 16 April, 2019 Bench: S.Manikumar, Subramonium Prasad 1 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 16.04.2019 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice S.Manikumar and The Honourable Mr.Justice Subramonium Prasad W.P. No.32102 of 2017 V.Nandakumar .. Petitioner Vs. 1.The Secretary Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Room No.348, A-Wing Nirman Bhawan Government of India New Delhi - 110 002 2.The Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Fda Bhawan Near Bal Bhavan Kolta Road New Delhi - 110 002 3.The Secretary Office of the Ministry of Law and Justice Government of India 4th Floor 'A' Wing, Shasthri Bhawan Rajendra Prasad Road New Delhi - 110 001 4.The Commissioner of Food Safety Office of the Commissioner of Food Safety 5th Floor of Dms Chennai - 600 006 http://www.judis.nic.in 2 5.The Secretary Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Department Govt. of Tamil Nadu Secretariat V.Nandakumar vs The Secretary on 16 April, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57158548/ 1 Chennai 600 009 6.The Secretary Ministry of Home Govt. of Tamil Nadu Chennai - 600 009 .. Respondents Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking a Writ Of Mandamus directing ban use of newspaper and plastic bags for wrapping/packing/serving food. For Petitioner : Mr.P.R.Balasubramanian For Respondent : Mr.S.Namo Narayanan for R1 & R3 Mr.H.S.Hredai for R2 Mr.E.Manokaran, Addl. Govt. Pleader for R4 to R6 ----- Order
texts.facts: Petitioner has sought for a writ of mandamus directing ban on use of newspaper and plastic bags for wrapping/packing/serving food. Supporting the same, documents have been filed in the typed set of papers. I deny all the averments made in the above Writ Petition except those that are specifically admitted hereunder. To food business operators overall 788 awareness meetings were conducted and about 80484 Food Business Operators were inspected during that period for restraining use of news paper for packing food items. Moreover with regard to restriction of use of newspaper for packing of food items and polythene cover packing, awareness notices, pamphlets were issued and overall 3968.5 Kg of newspaper which was kept for food packing were seized and destroyed in all 32 districts. During the month of May 2017, The Food Safety Department of Tamil Nadu Launched a Whatsapp Number "9444042322 for complaint redressal on Food Safety issues in Tamil Nadu. Awareness is being created among Food Business Operators and the consumers in all Districts. Moreover along with awareness campaigns, awareness notices, pamphlets were issued. And 37160 shops have been inspected and overall 12089.5 kg of plastics were seized in 32 districts in the state and 248 numbers of Notices were issued under respective Acts/Rules. 9. It is further submitted that the ban is brought under the environment protection Act, 1986, based upon that the Tamil Nadu Food Safety department create drive to awareness throughout Tamil Nadu regarding ban the use of Plastic bags/Sheets to wrap/packing/serve food items. 3. From the above, we find that adequate steps have been taken by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Tamil Nadu and Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai, to prevent use of newspapers and plastic bags wrapping/packing/serving food. Details at page 14 of the typed set of papers filed by the respondents, also goes to show that the Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Chennai has taken action, conducted several awareness meetings and also seized food items and destroyed. Notices to 288 persons have been issued from December 2016 to March 2019.
texts.arguments: 2. It is submitted that the writ Petitioner had filed a writ of Mandamus to direct the Respondents to Ban use of newspaper and plastic bags for wrapping / Packing / Serving Food. V.Nandakumar vs The Secretary on 16 April, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57158548/ 2 3. It is submitted that the Petitioner filed this writ petition to Ban the use of old newspapers and Plastic bags/Sheets to wrap/Pack/Serve Food items in various grounds. In the writ petition he has stated that unhygienic road side eateries, small and mini sized restaurants and such eateries throughout India are using old newspapers/polythene bags to parcel/wrap/serve the Food items. This may cause ill health and injury to public health. Moreover using newspapers which are printed with ink will cause many type of cancer. Plastic bags used in carrying hot liquid food items like tea, coffee etc, made up of polythene (Polythene) may also cause long and stomach cancer are the allegations / averments of the petitioner. http://www.judis.nic.in 4. It is further submitted that in the writ petition the petitioner has stated that Respondents have not taken any steps to ban the usages of newspapers/polythene bags in packing/wrapping serving food items. It is wholly incorrect and unacceptable one. 5. It is humbly submitted that the Food Safety and standard authority of India sent the Letter to all State Commissioner of Food Safety in file No.1/stds/Newspaper packing/FSSAI - 2016 dated on 06.12.2016 restricting the use of newspaper as food packing material. In that FSSAI letter it has categorically been stated that what are all the ill effects that will happen to consumer by taking newspaper packed food material. That FSSAI Letter was circulated to all states Commissioner of Food Safety to initiate a systematic campaign for generating awareness amongst all stakeholders to discourage the use of newspapers for packing, serving and storing of food items.
